§6Xenon-135

§aThe reactor poison. Builds up when your RBMK runs too cool and kills reactivity.

§bXenon-135§f is an extremely radioactive isotope (§e3,750 RAD/s§f, naturally pyrophoric) that poisons RBMK reactors at low power. When fuel receives low flux, Xe-135 accumulates faster than it burns.

§6Mechanics§f:
• Xenon generated at rate ×0.5 of flux (most fuels)
• Xenon burned at rate x²/50 of flux
• At §e25+ flux§f output, fuel stays xenon-free
• At §e100% poisoning§f, no flux reaches the rod
• Neutron sources and some late-game fuels are immune

§6Management§f: If Xe-135 builds up, expose the fuel rod to a neutron source to burn it off before disassembly. Burning too aggressively can cause dangerous flux spikes.

§6Extraction§f: §e1%§f chance for a tiny pile when recycling poisoned fuel in a SILEX.

§6Uses§f: Currently none beyond combining 9 tiny piles into 1 powder. Pure waste to manage.

§ePS:§f Xenon reduces recycling yields. Burn it off before processing spent fuel for better returns.
